references.text: The Israelites gathered to hear about the wickedness that had occurred, which is the background for the call to give counsel and guidance.
The horrific incident involving the Levite's concubine led to all the children of Israel being summoned to take a stand on the matter.
Another example where the entire congregation of Israel gathers to deliberate over a serious issue affecting the whole people.
Solomon encourages seeking advice from many counselors, which reflects the call in Judges 20:7 to give counsel and guidance.
The follow-up to the assembly where Israel remains gathered to make decisions concerning the entire people.
